summary: Iteration 67 — Test Lab + controlled rollout system verified end-to-end. Ran 16 pytest cases (all passed) covering Test Lab existence + 32 preloaded pages, archive/purge/delete protection, non-admin 403 on both /test-lab/rollout and /templates/{key}/rollout, wrong-confirm + no-scopes validation, full rollout job lifecycle with snapshot writing and tenant-content invariance (name/description/pages/leads unchanged after theme rollout), template rollout status (32 templates), template discard, and rollout-admin CRUD. Ran a Playwright pass on Dashboard, Test Lab editor, non-test tenant editor, and Template Gallery — every required data-testid renders, the 'Push to All Tenants' modal shows all 6 scopes + the exact warning + CONFIRM gate, and the Pending Rollout badge + gallery-pending-count light up when template_states.status='pending' is forced. Verified PART 4 regression: backend restart produces exactly 'Test Lab re-themed: 1 tenant(s)' + 'Templates pending rollout: 0', and the non-test tenant app_03efdf8b1af4 theme hash is byte-identical before and after restart. Zero destructive operations were performed on existing tenants.
